title: Rabbi Betzalah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bamidbar Rabbah 12:8, where Rabbi Berekhyah speaks in his name; Hyman says the reading should be Rabbi Betzalel, as the statement is cited in Shir HaShirim Rabbah, end of chapter 3.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital text of Bamidbar Rabbah 12:8 has Betzalah, and its Shir HaShirim Rabbah paragraph at the end of chapter 3 has Betzalel. Hyman’s proposed harmonization is translated as his proposal; the two witness forms remain distinct.

The whole Torat Emet Bamidbar Rabbah 12:8 paragraph has Rabbi Berekhyah in Rabbi Betzalah’s name, while the whole Shir HaShirim Rabbah paragraph at the end of chapter 3 has Rabbi Berekhyah in Rabbi Betzalel’s name. These support the local full titles and direction. Hyman’s “should read” retains its force and attribution, with both witness forms and the existing note preserved rather than merged.
